audit_method: Machine-readable matrix, raw summaries, raw samples, configuration manifests, completion records, environment captures, billing ledger, and source archives were cross-checked. No benchmark was re-run.

authoritative_matrix.qualification_rule: A completed engine row is qualified only when its reported FP64-oracle recall meets the configured target; failed, unavailable, invalid-harness, or recall-gate rows remain visible and are not promoted to timed comparisons.

source_archives.selector_source: Simple full-rescan top-k selector; byte-identical to the WGSL member in baseline-source.tar.gz
source_archives.qualification_status: This local source is not used to relabel retained remote rows.

claims.exact_claim: On the 10000 x 384 unfiltered RTX 4090 WGPU lifecycle run, add-one, delete-one, add-batch, and delete-batch first-search P95 values are 0.598, 0.631, 0.740, and 0.819 ms respectively; mutation cells rebuilt zero times, deletion checks passed, reopen took 52.169 ms, and the separate first search after reopen took 101.296 ms with one rebuilt resident state.
claims.dataset_provenance: Unfiltered synthetic lifecycle corpus; N=10000, D=384.
claims.N_dimension_batch_k_eligible_fraction: N=10000, D=384, mutation write batch=8, search B=1, k=10, eligible fraction 1.0.
claims.timing_boundary: Mutation rows report mutation_ns and a separate first_search_ns. The harness records reopen_ns for Collection::open and then starts a new timer for search; the matrix lifecycle:reopen P95 is the search-only 101.296 ms field, while 52.169 ms is the separate open cost.
claims.sample_and_repetition_count: 3 repetitions for each mutation phase; one reopen observation.
claims.correctness_oracle: 10-result shape and immediate-deletion checks; deleted_id_absent=true in all delete rows.
claims.memory_scope: Per-row allocation bytes are diagnostic; host RSS is explicitly unavailable in lifecycle summary.
claims.limitations: A single host and one unfiltered workload; mutation latency is separate from first-search latency.

configuration_accounting.primary_target_interpretation: The first ten entries in research/runpod/small-collection-configurations.json are the primary offer target; deep/reference/retry/fix entries are follow-up configurations. The matrix keeps all follow-up rows visible.
configuration_accounting.caution: The phrase ten configurations attempted refers to the campaign's primary target and controller attempts, not ten distinct successful hardware measurements; the 15-entry manifest includes follow-up and retry records.

raw_discrepancies.issue: Source archive role versus durable worktree selector
raw_discrepancies.observation: current-source.tar.gz (bb195...) contains the lane-minimum WGSL candidate, baseline-source.tar.gz (f37e...) contains the simpler full-rescan selector, and the audited local crates/qenlo/src/gpu_exact.wgsl is byte-identical to baseline WGSL.
raw_discrepancies.resolution: Treat lane-minimum rows as a frozen experimental candidate comparison and describe the durable implementation as the simpler selector. Do not relabel candidate rows as current durable behavior.
raw_discrepancies.source: Source archive comparison and direct WGSL byte hashes above.

raw_discrepancies.observation: benchmark_small_vectors.py and replay rows use prefiltered canonical eligible vectors; build_and_filter_prepare_ns is separate.
raw_discrepancies.resolution: Do not claim external rows include the same predicate evaluation work as native corpus-scope rows. State each timing boundary explicitly.
raw_discrepancies.source: scripts/benchmark_small_vectors.py, matrix filter_scope/timing_scope fields, corrected raw configuration files.

raw_discrepancies.observation: lifecycle matrix P95 fields are first-search P95; mutation_p95_ns is a separate mutation field. The harness times Collection::open as reopen_ns, then starts a new timer for the first search, so reopen_first_search_ns is search-only despite the broad summary timing_scope string.
raw_discrepancies.resolution: Report mutation, open, and first-search costs separately. Do not add reopen_ns and reopen_first_search_ns into an invented composite unless explicitly recomputed from a raw timer.

raw_discrepancies.observation: campaign-summary.json stores startedSpendUsd=0.9096019977878312 and finalKnownSpendUsd=0.9400778694252952, both daily account captures; the file also says billingDelayPossible=true.
raw_discrepancies.resolution: Call finalKnownSpendUsd account daily spend, not campaign-only cost. The observed delta is descriptive and may be affected by delayed billing or unrelated account usage.
